episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Sheriff Justin Wise's peaceful routine of serving and protecting the town of Blue Ridge while co-parenting his teenage daughter goes up in flames when the town's police station is burned to the ground under mysterious and very deadly circumstances.

episodes.title: The Legend of Oak Miller
episodes.summary: Thrill-seekers stage a Western-style stickup on an old country road, attracting the attention of Justin and his team, as well as the retribution of their victim, a legendary bull rider with a reputation for violence.

episodes.title: Heels and Faces
episodes.summary: The shady promoter of a local pro wrestling alliance is found dead under the ring at the Blue Ridge High School. As Justin and the team dig into his past, they find that almost everyone he knew had a motive to kill.

episodes.title: Appalachian Waltz
episodes.summary: A rare day off for Justin is ruined when a hard-living country band's tour bus breaks down. Just must manage both the romantic interest of their beautiful violinist and the havoc that their bully of a bodyguard is wreaking all over town.

episodes.title: Land Grab
episodes.summary: A beloved local horse trainer is killed on the eve of her retirement, and when Justin's team discovers her will, it contains a last-minute change that may be the reason for her death.

episodes.title: Locked In
episodes.summary: Justin's world is rocked when his ex-wife and daughter are held hostage at the Blue Ridge police station by an angry army veteran. Desperate to keep his family safe, Justin surrenders his gun and locks himself in with the hostages.

episodes.title: Hope, Deferred
episodes.summary: Sheriff Justin Wise has his hands full when Bounty Hunter Hope Henry comes into town in pursuit of a fugitive who is accused of murdering her mentor.

episodes.title: Going Around in Circles
episodes.summary: When a member of the Hughes racing dynasty ends up dead, it's up to Sheriff Justin Wise to solve the case involving rivals, lovers, and family secrets.

episodes.title: Out of the Woods
episodes.summary: A father-daughter camping trip turns treacherous when Sheriff Justin Wise and Maddie accidentally discover the hideout of several dangerous drug dealers.

episodes.title: Four-Rail Kick
episodes.summary: An old friend of Justin's makes an unexpected visit. It becomes clear that his visit is less about catching up and more about his gambling debt.

episodes.title: The Return of Oak Miller
episodes.summary: A deadly new drug hits the hollers of Blue Ridge just as an old foe of Justin's arrives back in town. With no other options, Justin must form an unconventional alliance in order to stop the flow of drugs and bring this menace to justice.

episodes.title: Montagues and Moonshine
episodes.summary: A murder at the local theater turns a production of Romeo and Juliet upside down as Justin and Maddie work together to discover the killer before the curtain falls on another victim.

episodes.title: A Matter of Perspective
episodes.summary: After an officer involved shooting threatens to ignite a long-standing feud in Blue Ridge, Justin must wade through the fog of the incident to find the truth.

episodes.title: Moving Mountains
episodes.summary: After a devastating landslide, Justin and Elli race against time to free and transport two injured people down a treacherous mountain pass to medical help before it is too late.
